brief:
Israeli forces detained at least 20 Palestinians during military operations in Hebron, the occupied West Bank city under ongoing siege, Middle East Eye reported. The detentions occurred as part of search operations carried out by the military.

The siege has displaced more than an unspecified number of residents from their homes. Israeli forces have maintained a security presence in Hebron as part of broader operations in the territory.

title: Israeli forces detain 20 Palestinians in Hebron siege
